notes.owns: Its OWN D1 from Phase 1 (01-TARGET.md row 20, plan 1.7) — `audit_events` and `audit_chain_heads` live in `levonis-audit-db`, not in the shared database. The legacy `audit_log` stays in the core's D1 and is frozen read-only after Phase 3; this service never names it, so it is deliberately absent from `owns` even though the design assigns the table to Audit. `audit_processed_events` and `audit_idempotency` are platform tables of this service.
notes.reads: Empty: Audit joins nothing. A query that needs a user's name is answered by the caller, not here — Audit holds the fact, not the person.
notes.calls: Only Identity's public-key registry, to verify producers' event signatures (03-EVENTS.md §1). Audit calls nobody else: a log that depends on the systems it audits is not a log. `ALLOWED_CALLER_KIDS` is the bootstrap alternative and the only source in dark.
notes.publishes: Nothing in Phase 1. Audit is a sink; `AuditRecorded` is produced by every OTHER service through the audit() facade.
notes.consumes: Exactly the `audit` rows of packages/contracts/src/subscriptions.ts — AuditRecorded plus the privileged/money events of 03-EVENTS.md §6. Adding one here without adding it there fails tests/eventSchemas.test.ts.
notes.secrets: AUDIT_CHAIN_KEY keys the chain HMAC (an attacker with database write access cannot recompute a consistent chain without it); AUDIT_SIGNING_KEY is this Worker's hop key (`<SVC>_SIGNING_KEY`, 01-TARGET.md §4 item 3); HEALTH_PROBE_TOKEN lets the deep-health probe reach a Worker that has no URL. Names only — no value is ever in the repository.
